docs.text: They also want control of the Great Lakes, this is never stopping until they have it

They want to make everyone pay for the privilege to know if their crops need frost protection, if their ships will make it across the Great Lakes, if their power grids need to be watched. This is more than whether or not you need a raincoat.
Fucking insane that in 2025, I'm here on the shores of the Great Lakes having to fight for my rights as an Englishman.
We will deal with both Notre Dame and OSU during the drafting of our Constitution of the Independent Great Lakes. We do not negotiate with terrorists.

I've been saying for years that soon all the Great Lakes states and provinces will have to defend their homes and water with lethal force, because in 25-50 years everyone *everywhere* will want to live here or take our goods as the entire rest of the world shrivels away.

but yeah if you are talking the water wars, I'm in the same boat. if the US decides to secure the great lakes I guess I get to become an american citizen, assuming they don't just burn everything within 100km of the lakes to the ground
